faqs.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.a: Cancel in two clicks from your Account page with zero mandatory calls or surveys; access continues until the end of your billing period.

faqs.q: What happens if I reach my monthly limit?
faqs.a: We never interrupt an in-progress result. You will see a calm notice with your reset date and an optional one-step upgrade.

faqs.q: What happens to my projects and data if I cancel or delete my account?
faqs.a: Export your full data archive as JSON or PDF/DOCX anytime. Account deletion requests include a 14-day recovery window before permanent purge.
